title: The Devil’s Fork
subtitle: the impossible fork, or blivet, engraved stroke by stroke
technique: Contour ambiguity: the same six lines are the outlines of three round prongs at one end and the edges of a square U-shaped bar at the other
refs: D. H. Schuster, A New Ambiguous Figure: A Three-Stick Clevis, American Journal of Psychology, 1964
blurb: Six engraved lines make three round prongs at one end and two square bars at the other; slide a card over either half and each is a perfectly good object.
